cases.setup_script:
: > "$HOME/control.txt"
kat=$(printf %s password | /usr/bin/argon2 somesalt -id -t 2 -k 65536 -p 1 -l 32 -r)
[[ $kat == 09316115d5cf24ed5a15a31a3ba326e5cf32edc24702987c02b6566f61913cf7 ]]
enc=$(printf %s password | /usr/bin/argon2 somesalt -id -t 2 -k 65536 -p 1 -l 32 -e)
[[ $enc == '$argon2id$v=19$m=65536,t=2,p=1$c29tZXNhbHQ$CTFhFdXPJO1aFaMaO6Mm5c8y7cJHAph8ArZWb2GRPPc' ]]
printf 'argon2: reference vector password/somesalt t=2 m=65536 p=1 raw and encoded match\n' >> "$HOME/control.txt"
[[ $(/usr/bin/python3 -I phc.py oracle "$enc" kat.pw) == kdf=match ]]
[[ $(/usr/bin/python3 -I phc.py oracle '$argon2id$v=19$m=65536,t=2,p=1$736f6d6573616c74$09316115d5cf24ed5a15a31a3ba326e5cf32edc24702987c02b6566f61913cf7' kat.pw) == kdf=match ]]
printf 'phc.py: reference vector recomputed from the B64 and hex layouts\n' >> "$HOME/control.txt"
cases.purpose: Regression for independent hex and standard Base64 PHC rows and strict malformed PHC rejection.
cases.oracle: Argon2id per RFC 9106 computed by the independent argon2 CLI (phc-winner-argon2 20190702, /usr/bin/argon2) in the guest; the PHC string format (password-hashing competition 'PHC string format': $argon2id$v=19$m=M,t=T,p=P$<salt>$<hash> with salt and hash in unpadded standard B64, as argon2 -e and libargon2 produce); passwd(1)/shadow(5): changing a password sets the last-change day and keeps the other aging fields, the account must exist, and the database is unchanged on refusal. Parameters: PHCLIB_M/PHCLIB_T/PHCLIB_P and the documented defaults m=19456, t=2, p=1 (passwd.c header; RFC 9106 second recommended set). A trailing newline ends the password read from the descriptor (chpasswd/--stdin convention). setup_script runs the CLI on the reference test vector before anything else. A verifier accepts PHC strings in the standard encoding; locked ('!' prefix), '*' and empty password fields never authenticate (shadow(5), passwd -l); malformed or non-argon2id strings are rejected.
cases.comparison: Exact status (class for rejected rows) and empty stdout per attempt.
cases.script:
[[ $(type -t passwd) == builtin ]] || { printf 'candidate passwd builtin missing\n'; exit 99; }
export BASHPASSWD_KERNEL_SECRETS=0 PHCLIB_PASSWD=db/passwd PHCLIB_SHADOW=db/shadow PHCLIB_GROUP=db/group PHCLIB_M=1024 PHCLIB_T=1 PHCLIB_P=1
reset_db() { /usr/bin/rm -rf db; /usr/bin/mkdir db; /usr/bin/cp pristine/passwd pristine/group pristine/shadow db/; /usr/bin/chmod 600 db/shadow; }
snap() { /usr/bin/rm -rf snap; /usr/bin/cp -a db snap; }
same() { /usr/bin/cmp -s db/passwd snap/passwd && /usr/bin/cmp -s db/group snap/group && /usr/bin/cmp -s db/shadow snap/shadow && echo unchanged || echo changed; }
residue() { local n=0 f; for f in "$1"/* "$1"/.[!.]*; do [[ -e $f ]] || continue; case ${f##*/} in passwd|group|shadow) ;; *) n=$((n + 1)) ;; esac; done; echo "$n"; }
rc_class() { (( $1 == 0 )) && echo 0 || echo nonzero; }
today=$(( $(printf '%(%s)T' -1) / 86400 ))
phc() { /usr/bin/python3 -I phc.py "$@"; }
reset_db
salt=somesalt12345678
hexsalt=$(printf %s "$salt" | /usr/bin/od -An -tx1 | /usr/bin/tr -d ' \n')
raw=$(/usr/bin/argon2 "$salt" -id -t 1 -k 1024 -p 1 -l 32 -r < pw.raw)
B64ROW=$(/usr/bin/argon2 "$salt" -id -t 1 -k 1024 -p 1 -l 32 -e < pw.raw)
HEXROW='$argon2id$v=19$m=1024,t=1,p=1$'$hexsalt'$'$raw
setrow() { /usr/bin/awk -F: -v OFS=: -v u="$1" -v h="$2" '$1 == u { $2 = h; found = 1 } { print } END { if (!found) print u, h, "19000", "0", "99999", "7", "", "", "" }' db/shadow > db/shadow.new && /usr/bin/mv db/shadow.new db/shadow; /usr/bin/chmod 600 db/shadow; }
export BPW_LOCK_DIR=$PWD/lock
setrow alice "$HEXROW"; setrow carol "$B64ROW"
v() {  # LABEL USER FILE exact|class
  local label=$1 user=$2 file=$3 rc o
  passwd verify-fd "$user" 3 3< "$file" > out.v 2> "$HOME/err.$label"; rc=$?
  [[ -s out.v ]] && o=nonempty || o=empty
  [[ $4 == class ]] && rc=$(rc_class "$rc")
  printf '%s rc=%s stdout=%s\n' "$label" "$rc" "$o"
}
v hex-wrong alice wrong exact
v hex-correct alice pw exact
v hex-correct-unterminated alice pw.raw exact
v b64-wrong carol wrong exact
v b64-correct carol pw exact
setrow locked "!$HEXROW"; setrow star '*'; setrow empty ''
setrow shorthash '$argon2id$v=19$m=1024,t=1,p=1$'$hexsalt'$'${raw:0:30}
setrow badversion '$argon2id$v=16$m=1024,t=1,p=1$'$hexsalt'$'$raw
setrow lowmem '$argon2id$v=19$m=512,t=1,p=1$'$hexsalt'$'$raw
setrow argon2i '$argon2i$v=19$m=1024,t=1,p=1$'$hexsalt'$'$raw
for u in locked star empty shorthash badversion lowmem argon2i nosuch; do v "row-$u" "$u" pw class; done
passwd verify-fd > /dev/null 2>&1; printf 'no-args rc=%d\n' "$?"
passwd verify-fd alice > /dev/null 2>&1; printf 'no-fd rc=%d\n' "$?"
setrow mixedcase '$argon2id$v=19$m=1024,t=1,p=1$'"${hexsalt^^}"'$'"${raw^^}"
v uppercase-hex mixedcase pw exact
setrow padded "${B64ROW}="
setrow extra "${B64ROW}\$"
setrow duplicate '$argon2id$v=19$m=1024,t=1,p=1,m=1024$'"$hexsalt"'$'"$raw"
setrow unknown '$argon2id$v=19$m=1024,t=1,p=1,x=1$'"$hexsalt"'$'"$raw"
setrow gap '$argon2id$v=19$m=1024,,t=1,p=1$'"$hexsalt"'$'"$raw"
for u in padded extra duplicate unknown gap; do v "strict-$u" "$u" pw class; done
/usr/bin/rm -rf db snap lock out.v
cases.stdout:
hex-wrong rc=1 stdout=empty
hex-correct rc=0 stdout=empty
hex-correct-unterminated rc=0 stdout=empty
b64-wrong rc=1 stdout=empty
b64-correct rc=0 stdout=empty
row-locked rc=nonzero stdout=empty
row-star rc=nonzero stdout=empty
row-empty rc=nonzero stdout=empty
row-shorthash rc=nonzero stdout=empty
row-badversion rc=nonzero stdout=empty
row-lowmem rc=nonzero stdout=empty
row-argon2i rc=nonzero stdout=empty
row-nosuch rc=nonzero stdout=empty
no-args rc=2
no-fd rc=2
uppercase-hex rc=0 stdout=empty
strict-padded rc=nonzero stdout=empty
strict-extra rc=nonzero stdout=empty
strict-duplicate rc=nonzero stdout=empty
strict-unknown rc=nonzero stdout=empty
strict-gap rc=nonzero stdout=empty
